AI Reliability Engineering

Reliable, measurable and efficient AI systems

We design acceptance rules, evidence checks, recovery paths, and cost-per-success measurements for enterprise agents, research tools, and workflows.

Business problems

  • A plausible answer still needs to satisfy the task, format, and permission requirements.
  • When a tool fails or a citation cannot be found, the workflow needs a defined retry, fallback, or human review path.
  • Lower token use can come with lower completion rates. Quality and cost must be compared together.

Engineering capabilities

  • Define task success with a reproducible task set, preserving inputs, outputs, and failure causes at each stage.
  • Convert citation, number, permission, and schema requirements into repeatable verification rules.
  • Compare single-agent, rule-verified, and multi-agent workflows on equivalent tasks for quality, latency, and cost.

Frequently asked questions

Can you evaluate the models and agents we already use?

Yes. We fix the deployed model versions and representative tasks first. Equivalent inputs, tool permissions, and pricing assumptions make the comparison meaningful.

Does every check need a second model?

Schemas, allowed values, source matching, and number context are candidates for deterministic checks. Human or model judgment can cover requirements that resist explicit rules, within a stated evaluation scope.
